title: Can't Be Evil NFT License Picker
description: Deterministic rights-matrix lookup mapping creator answers (commercial, exclusivity, no-hate variant) to one of a16z's six Can't Be Evil NFT licenses (launch names CBE-CC0, ECR, NECR, NECR-HS, PR, PR-HS; current on-chain names PUBLIC through PERSONAL_NO_HATE, renamed in place October 2022, order unchanged). Returns license id, both on-chain enum names, Solidity LicenseVersion enum ordinal, full rights matrix verified against the canonical Arweave license texts, and canonical Arweave license URIs (current and legacy manifests, equivalent per index). Selection only, not legal advice. Zero PII.

mcp_tool_definition.name: cbe_nft_license_picker
mcp_tool_definition.description: Maps creator rights answers (waive all, commercial use, exclusivity, no-hate variant) to one of a16z's six Can't Be Evil NFT licenses with both on-chain enum names (launch and current), the Solidity LicenseVersion enum ordinal, full rights matrix verified against the canonical Arweave license texts, and canonical Arweave license URIs. Deterministic. Use when a creator or agent needs to pick a standard NFT license to reference from a token contract. Selection only, not legal advice.

exclusive.description: Exclusive commercial rights (only when commercial; qualified, no trademark rights)

hate_speech_termination.description: Include the no-hate variant (broad objectionable-use restriction, license section 1.6, enforced by breach termination, not auto-termination)
